scientific_limitations: Only ordinary 3-cut, only Möbius ladders on 2n vertices with n>=4.
Integral nonequivariant homotopy; no shellability, group representation, or higher-k assertion.
Finite exhaustive and mod-two checks corroborate but cannot replace the all-n proof.
Unindexed or inaccessible equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Ordinary three-cut complexes of Möbius ladders are uniform sphere wedges
